mapper.select: select d.id, d.departmentname as name, d.supdepid as parent, d.subcompanyid1, s.subcompanyname as subcompany_name, d.canceled, d.showorder from hrmdepartment d left join hrmsubcompany s on s.id = d.subcompanyid1 where (d.canceled is null or d.canceled <> '1') order by d.subcompanyid1, d.supdepid, d.showorder, d.id

select d.id, d.departmentname as name, d.supdepid as parent, d.subcompanyid1, s.subcompanyname as subcompany_name, d.allsupdepid as allSupDepId, d.tlevel as tlevel, d.canceled from hrmdepartment d left join hrmsubcompany s on s.id = d.subcompanyid1 where d.id = #{deptId}
select id from hrmresource where loginid = #{loginid}
select r.id from hrmresource r where r.status in (0, 1, 2, 3) and r.loginid is not null and r.loginid <> '' and r.mobile = #{mobile} order by r.id
select r.id from hrmresource r where r.status in (0, 1, 2, 3) and r.loginid is not null and r.loginid <> '' and r.email = #{email} order by r.id

select r.id, r.lastname, r.loginid, r.mobile, r.email, r.workcode, r.departmentid as department_id, d.departmentname as department_name, r.subcompanyid1 as subcompany_id, s.subcompanyname as subcompany_name, r.status, r.resourceimageid as resource_image_id, r.accounttype as account_type, r.belongto as belong_to from hrmresource r left join hrmdepartment d on d.id = r.departmentid left join hrmsubcompany s on s.id = r.subcompanyid1 where r.id = #{id}

select r.id, r.lastname, r.loginid, r.mobile, r.workcode, r.departmentid as department_id, d.departmentname as department_name, r.status, r.accounttype as account_type, r.belongto as belong_to from hrmresource r left join hrmdepartment d on d.id = r.departmentid where r.id = #{mainId} or r.belongto = #{mainId} order by r.accounttype, r.id
